excerpt_i18n.en:
Author: Yang Yiting  Editor: Bao Yonggang

Amid the long-standing dominance of international giants like NVIDIA in the AI chip sector, Jiangyuan Technology has carved a path through constraints with its first fully domestically produced advanced-process AI chip, the D10, as a blade, and the fully autonomous D20 series acceleration cards as armor. From facing critical funding shortages and R&D setbacks in its darkest hours to the triumph of successful tape-out and the steady progress of mass production, this startup’s breakthrough journey vividly illustrates the domestic chip industry’s determination to confront challenges head-on.

Answering the Call in Crisis: Embarking with a Belief in National Duty

On October 7, 2022, the U.S. Department of Commerce’s 139-page export control order struck the Chinese semiconductor industry like a thunderbolt. Provisions for "comprehensive restrictions on high-performance chip design tools and manufacturing processes" pushed domestic chips into a dire situation where self-reliance was the only way out. Li Ying, then leading AI chip R&D at Suiyuan Technology, stayed awake all night. Years later, she recalled that it was the conviction of "putting national interests above personal weal and woe" that spurred her to dedicate herself to overcoming challenges in domestic chip development.

"The lessons from the sanctions on ZTE and Huawei taught us that core technology cannot be bought or begged for," Li Ying noted. Her career has closely paralleled the breakthrough history of China’s chip industry. From being among the first employees at AMD’s Beijing R&D center to a key technical leader at Suiyuan Technology, she has contributed to the mass production of world-leading GPUs and witnessed the layered advancements in domestic chip processes and ecosystems.
excerpt_i18n.es: Autor: Yang Yiting. Editor: Bao Yonggang. "Aunque el cribado es arduo, solo al eliminar la arena gruesa se alcanza el oro". En el campo de los chips de IA, dominado durante mucho tiempo por gigantes internacionales como NVIDIA, Jiangyuan Technology ha abierto un camino en medio del asedio de restricciones, utilizando su primer chip de IA totalmente nacional y de proceso avanzado, el D10, como espada, y la serie de tarjetas de aceleración D20, completamente autónomas y controlables, como armadura. Desde momentos críticos con fondos escasos y obstáculos en I+D, hasta la alegría del éxito en la fabricación y los pasos firmes hacia la producción en masa, la lucha de esta startup es un vivo ejemplo de la determinación de la industria nacional de chips de "avanzar decididamente a pesar de los desafíos". Asumiendo la responsabilidad en tiempos difíciles: comenzar con la convicción de "si beneficia al país, daría incluso la vida".

Traditional Computer System Validation (CSV) approaches, often with uniform validation strategies, are being supplemented by Computer Software Assurance (CSA) frameworks that emphasize flexible risk-based validation methods tailored to each system's actual impact and complexity (FDA latest guidance). In this post, we cover a risk-based implementation, practical implementation considerations across different risk levels, the AWS shared responsibility model for compliance, and concrete examples of risk mitigation strategies.
